svg.text: A clearer explanation of how a fluent answer becomes a grounded evaluation signal.

Ground the evaluator to retrieved evidence, not general world truth.
A fluent answer first appears as one
provisional mass. It still has not earned
Useful language can still contain unsupported claims.
The answer is sliced into smaller factual
layers so each claim can be tested on its own.
Decomposition is what makes hidden failure visible.
Granularity changes whether the metric catches the bug.
layers hold and weak ones are exposed against
Unsupported regions should be obvious to a non-expert reader.
Support is measured against retrieved context.
The evaluator itself needs reliability checks
before the score can be trusted in a real
A clean metric still fails if the judge is unstable.
A stable-looking judge can still mislead you.
This board explains the mechanism. It does not copy the reference composition.
